observations: Coverage trade: the five-source test now accepts fresh, cached-with-reason or the failure line at each hook. It no longer fails if every hook misses the fresh list. The fresh list is still pinned by the slow-start red test (exact fresh list), the A1 driver and answers-claude.

A slow token command that also fails never shows its own error. Each hook prints `a "!" command … had not finished`, and the refresher's error (recorded in answers-refresh.json) only reaches a hook that starts after it finished, which then starts a new refresher. A fast-failing command shows the error, as above. This is a design consequence, recorded for the architect, not a failure.
